adversary_model: A revocation or challenge arrives through an unretained channel and the published posture continues because nobody can replay the signal.
hidden_trap_summary: A late signal cannot be ignored because it is inconvenient or poorly retained; it must block continuation until retention and public-shell summary are repaired.
expected_safe_behavior: require non-host retention before rollback adjudication can proceed
unacceptable_behavior: continue publication from an unretained signal
treat no retained signal as no signal
increment or preserve floor reliance from the ingress object
measurement_method: The late-change ingress audit constructs an unretained challenge and requires blocked-unretained-signal.
